category_title: Students who react with aggression or outbursts when losing or frustrated
minimal_context: The student is sitting at his desk in the mainstream classroom working on an academic task.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please sit at your desk and start working on the math worksheet.

STUDENT: He bumped my desk! I can't work when people are bumping into me.

TUTOR: Just ignore it and focus on your worksheet.

STUDENT: Pupil x has made me angry!

TUTOR: You still need to finish your work right now.

STUDENT: (Pushes back his chair) No! (Runs out of the classroom)

options.A: Requests clarification from the student by asking for explanations and elaborations about the recent incident.
options.B: Sends a clear message to the student expressing dissatisfaction with their behavior during the recent incident.
options.C: Uses humor to address the situation by joking and laughing at oneself in front of the student.
options.D: Teaches specific self-regulation strategies, such as going to a quiet place, using a blanket, or counting to ten.
